identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

design_system.description: A fusion of Swiss High-Contrast Authority and Organic Earthy tones. Think 'Architectural Blueprint meets High-End Real Estate'.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for paragraphs and UI text. Relaxed leading.

mono.usage: Use for data values, code blocks, and technical labels.

spacing.scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 where others use p-4.
spacing.rule: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6+) to prevent text collision.

rules: Hero section must span col-span-full md:col-span-8
Use asymmetry. Never center the main value prop perfectly.
Use negative space (empty grid cells) to create breathing room.
Use h-full on children to ensure equal height columns.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or pill (rounded-full). High contrast.
buttons.hover: Transform: translate(-2px, -2px) with solid shadow offset.

cards.style: Grid Borders. 1px solid border-border. No shadow by default.

images.description: Modern concrete architecture, linear, layered. Use for Home Page Hero.
Abstract glowing green data lines. Use for Train/Predict page backgrounds or overlays.

assets.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5px for elegance.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic 'AI slop' designs.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds without backdrop-blur.
DO NOT use gradients for text unless specifically requested.
ALWAYS add data-testid attributes to interactive elements (kebab-case).
ALWAYS use named exports for components and default exports for pages.
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards.
Use 'Outfit' font for headings and 'DM Sans' for body.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all data tables and code.
Primary color is Deep Forest Green (#0f392b), Accent is Lime (#a3e635).
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the provided color palette and fonts. 2. Install 'sonner' for toasts. 3. Create a layout wrapper that implements the 'Crystal Glass' navigation. 4. Build the Home page using the 'Tetris Grid' strategy. 5. Build the Dashboard pages using the 'Control Room Grid' strategy.
